newsitems.title: 🌾 PLAYTEST SIGNUPS ARE CLOSED
newsitems.author: alyssa
newsitems.contents: Hey everyone!Turns out gathering 23,000 people is way easier than finding one needle.Signups for the Needle In A Haystack Simulator playtest are now officially closed. Over 23,000 of you volunteered to dig through 5,000,000 pieces of hay with us — that's far more than we hoped for, and more than enough to run a proper test. Thank you ❤️Didn't make it in? Don't put the pitchfork away just yet. As soon as the first playable build is ready, we'll be giving away extra access keys to everyone who missed out — so keep an eye on our news.⚠️ One more thing: a bunch of clones have popped up lately, and it's getting easy to grab the wrong haystack. This page right here is the original game — the one you signed up for.Here's how you can help us right now:⭐ Add Needle In A Haystack Simulator to your WishlistWishlists directly boost our visibility on Steam. It's one click, it costs nothing, and it really does help a small team get noticed.💬 Join our DiscordThat's where news, playtest waves and key giveaways land first — before anywhere else. Link here: https://discord.gg/asZmmqnMv7See you in the hay 🌾
